name: Bow
description:
## Description

"Integrated amplifier with simple circuit design.The model name for WAZOO is taken from the 1972album ""The Grand Wazoo"" by Frank Zappa, a favorite artist of designer Poe Christensen. Wazoo means a large, primitive, but effective megaphone.The output circuit uses a single push-pull configuration using a pair of high-efficiency MOS-FETs.The simple design with single push-pull operation solves the problems of element matching, which cannot be avoided in parallel configuration with many elements, and the loss of dynamism and purity caused by the slow response of the amplifier.In addition, by reducing the number of active components from the input stage to the output stage and discharging NFB, dynamic and natural characteristics are realized.The power supply section is configured using a large transformer, and all the left and right channels are independent from the secondary side and beyond.The circuit board is a type with a 105Ï‰ m copper layer.In addition, audio-only parts such as WIMA polypropylene capacitor, ELMA selector switch, Lauderstein carbon film resistor, low noise / soft recovery diode, WBT connector are used to balance cost and performance.The volume is motor-driveable and is designed for volume control only with an optional remote controller sold separately.The chassis is made of all-aluminum to prevent the loss of sound quality due to magnetization that is inevitable with a steel chassis.The front panel is designed to be isolated from the chassis and has a simple layout with only input selector and volume knobs, monitor and standby switches."

description:
## Description

"This is an integrated amplifier with improved left and right channel separation and enhanced power based on WAZOO'Ωs design philosophy.The WAZOO XL uses a dual-mono configuration with completely independent power supplies for the left and right sides.A large toroidal transformer is used independently for the left and right channels, and a dual monaural construction realizes stable low-frequency reproduction without dynamic crosstalk.In addition, the output power has been increased by 50% to realize richer music playback.The output circuit consists of single-pair high-efficiency MOS-FET output elements per channel.By adopting a simple design of push-pull operation with a single pair, the problem of matching elements, which cannot be avoided with a high-power amplifier composed of many elements in parallel, and the problem of losing dynamism and purity by slowing down the response of the amplifier, are solved.Moreover, by newly using a small current feedback of 6dB, a faster response and a wide range are realized.The circuit board is heavy-duty with a 105Ï‰ m copper layer and uses high-quality audio-only components such as Wima polypropylene capacitors, Roderstein carbon-coated resistors, Elma selector switches, low-noise / soft recovery diodes, and WBT connectors.The volume uses a high-precision VR capable of motor drive.The chassis is made of all-aluminum to prevent degradation of sound quality due to magnetization that cannot be avoided with steel chassis.The front panel has a simple design with only a large input selector and volume controller knob, and two switches for monitor and standby. It is designed with precision machining and finishing.There was a remote controller as an option sold separately."

name: Bow
description:
## Description

"A stereo power amplifier with a powerful power supply and dual monaural construction.The voltage stage of the amplifier circuit uses a JFET/BJT cascode and high-efficiency current mirror configuration single amplification, and operates at a high supply voltage for a simple design close to the vacuum tube system. The driver stage also uses a single MOS-FET for high current configuration.The complimentary service stage consists of two high-power / high-speed MOS-FET output pairs.Current feedback is used instead of the normal voltage feedback.Since the current feedback is extremely fast, it has the advantage of reducing TIM distortion and other factors that interfere with sound quality and improving high-frequency characteristics.The feedback circuit is limited to a minimum value of 20dB.The power supply consists of four 350VA toroidal transformers, one for the positive and negative power supplies of each channel, for a total of 1400VA full dual monaural construction.We use carefully selected parts, such as Wima polypropylene capacitors, low ESR electrolytic capacitors, and high speed / soft reversible rectifiers.The input can be balanced or unbalanced.The WBT connector is used for the speaker output terminal for by-wire connection.It has a balanced and unbalanced throughput output that is convenient for bi-amplifier drive.When the main power supply of the rear panel is turned on, the logo letters of the front panel light up sequentially, and when all of them light up, the operation state is activated.The O part of the BOW logo on the front panel is the standby switch."

description:
## Description

"This control amplifier was developed based on the same circuit design concept as the power amplifier WALRUS.We have adopted a configuration that can be thought of as a model without the driver stage from WALRUS.By adopting a simple circuit configuration, it is possible to amplify a signal with high purity.The power supply is constructed by dual monaural construction with two large toroidal transformers.Both transformers are placed with elaborate shielding on both sides of the front panel side.The front panel inherits the design of the Integrated Amp WAZOO XL. It consists of a large volume knob, a selector knob, a standby button, a monitor button and indicators for each.The main power switch is located on the rear panel and is designed to be turned on / off by the standby button on the front panel. When the standby switch is pressed, the LED in the upper center of the front panel turns on and becomes operational.The monitor switch is used to monitor the signal recorded from the source device connected to the line inputs of the rear panel 1-5.There are four line-level inputs, balanced and unbalanced.Input5is used as a tape input and has a separate tape output.There are two types of pre-out, balanced and unbalanced, and bi-amplifier drive is also available.It comes with a wireless remote control WAND for volume adjustment."

name: Bow
description:
## Description

"A top-loading CD player.By adopting a top-loading system, the mechanism can be mounted at the center of gravity of the main body, enabling accurate tracking without being affected by disc vibration. The disc is held by a carefully machined proprietary large disc stabiliser and center magnet, providing a rigid and stable rotational.For the mechanism part, Philips'ΩCDM-12PRO is customized for the WIZARD. It is directly screwed to the top panel of 15mm thick aluminum for integration with the chassis. Compared with conventional methods such as suspending with rubber or spring, the structure is more stable.The D/A converter uses an 18-bit continuous calibration bit stream type D/A converter manufactured by Philips. The single-bit conversion makes the circuit relatively simple and, in principle, does not generate 0cross distortion, making it possible to perform natural conversion.In addition, a unique analog buffer circuit is used for the analog output to achieve the sound quality target.Inter IC-Sound(I2S) The transfer bus reduces jitter by effectively isolating the audio data, word clock and bit clock.The power supply consists mainly of a large toroidal transformer and a large-capacity filter.In addition, the digital and analog sections are completely independent, and a total of seven independent power supplies are used to completely eliminate interference between the drive, digital, analog, display and microprocessor sections. In addition, to take full advantage of independent power supplies, only the digital section power supply can be turned off so that the analog section is always energized.The analog outputs are unbalanced via the RCA connector and balanced via the XLR connector.The digital outputs consist of a total Route 3of RCAs, BNC coaxial connectors and XLR connectors.Dedicated remote controller RC-5is included.There was also an optional aluminum remote controller WAND with a stick-shaped form that was sold separately. This WAND has all the WIZARD functions as well as WAZOO volume control and can be used as the master controller of the WAZOO/WIZARD system."

name: Bow
description:
## Description

"A CD player developed with a design philosophy that pursues simplicity and straightness.For the pickup part, Philips CDM-12PRO is customized for the ZZ Eight.By fastening screws directly to the heavy solid brass structure and integrating it with the chassis, the drive section can be supported more rigidly than the suspension system using rubber or spring. Therefore, everything other than the rotating mechanism and pickup can be kept as quiet as possible. As a result, stable tracking performance is obtained.Center mount top-loading system with CDM-12PRO mounted in the center of the case.The disc is equipped with a unique large disc stabilizer that is carefully lowered by machine to hold it securely by magnetic force. The center ring that positions the turntable and the disc is made of metal with no electrostatic capacity to eliminate the accumulation of static electricity that is harmful to the pickup.The D/A converter uses PCM1702, a 20-bit sign magnitude D/A converter manufactured by Bar Brown.The linearity of conventional multi-bit conversion depends on the error of the resistor used. If the error becomes large, the 0cross distortion generated when the signal switches from positive to negative through 0has an effect on the nuance of sound. On the other hand, single-bit conversion with a simple circuit does not generate 0cross distortion in principle, but has disadvantages such as a large amount of high-frequency noise. Sign magnitude conversion converts the plus and minus waveforms of signals independently, making it possible to realize digital reproduction without 0cross distortion, which is often the case with multi-bit conversion.The ZZ-Eight uses two PCM1702s for the left and right channels and a selection of the highest quality K-rank products to achieve excellent multi-bit conversion. The digital filter uses an 8x oversampling digital filter to achieve excellent sound quality.The DAC chips are stacked on top of each other in a stacking configuration. Compared with the conventional method of arranging them side by side on the substrate, the signal path is kept shorter and the temperature stability of each DAC chip is obtained.In the ZZ-STACK, all ICs in the signal path, such as filters, use this Eight configuration, resulting in good noise characteristics and high resolution in low-level playback.Parts include many non-magnetic carbon film resistors made by Radarstein, low-noise / soft recovery diodes for the power supply for the D/A converter, filter capacitors with a large capacity of 45,000Ï‰ F, and circuit boards with 2mm thick / 70Ï‰ m copper layers.There is only one unbalanced output system using RCA connector with Teflon insulator for the output terminal, and the design which unnecessarily complicates the circuit is avoided.The digital output has two systems, RCA and BNC coax.On / off of standby function and basic operation of transport are controlled by momentary type toggle switch lever.Interference between circuits is suppressed by using digital / analog independent power supply for the power supply part.In addition, it is equipped with a standby function that can turn off only the power supply of the digital part so that the analog circuit can be always energized, so that the music can always be enjoyed in the best condition.The operating status and disk information are displayed on the black acrylic part of the front panel.Display brightness can be switched to 3levels other than OFF.The ZZ-Eight is compact in size and has a heavy structure, which makes it less susceptible to vibration than larger sizes.Four rubber feet are used for the legs. The legs are soft considering the rigidity of the chassis. However, we selected the best material and shape for sound quality through more than 10kinds of trial listening and trial listening.Mechanical grounding can also be achieved by removing two rear rubber feet and attaching an included conical metal spike to the bottom surface in consideration of the condition of the grounding surface.HDCD format is also supported.Wireless remote control RC-5is included."
